_README_ControlPlane: shopflow-migrate connects DIRECTLY to Postgres (superuser), NOT through PgBouncer. All provisioning is DDL — CREATE DATABASE/ROLE, schema migrations, GRANTs — which the pgbouncer.ini template documents as a direct bypass. Routing the catalog migration through PgBouncer as shopflow_app created an app-role-before-catalog chicken-and-egg (shopflow_app is created during provision --tenant, but provision --catalog ran first). Services connect through PgBouncer (6432) as shopflow_app; the migrate tool does not.
